The animal and props are quiet context only. Design a new character; do not copy, trace, extract, crop, or recreate any character from a concept board, hero, or existing pilot asset.

Beside it are only a few closed blank field cards and one closed unbranded field guide with no visible pages. Color palette: warm mineral cream accents, deep teal ink and clothing, restrained coral accent, lichen/olive support, warm brown otter fur and field-guide props; quiet field-atlas palette. Background is only #FF00FF.
Materials/textures: crisp tapered linework, softly brushed fills, subtle cel-shaded fur and fabric texture inside the subject and props only; closed cards and guide have clean unmarked surfaces; no texture on magenta.

Constraints: output a lossless PNG chroma-key source with perfectly flat #FF00FF background and no alpha; text-free; no letters, numbers, logo, watermark, emoji, UI, data, private information, chart, status, progress, completion, search, category, arrows, magnifying glass, badges, ticks, checkmarks, or semantic symbol; no other characters, no extra props beyond the field cards and guide, no exercise equipment, no branded objects, no magenta pixels inside the subject, no checkerboard.
